name: NICK'S HOUSE
blurb: Clear the wreckage of a life once imagined.
how: Drag the packing boxes to the edges of the screen.

win.title: The Void is Orderly
win.body: The room is empty, as hollow as the promises of the East Egg.
win.quote: And so with the sunshine and the great bursts of laughter that had come from Gatsby's house throughout the summer, the world roared in the summer

lose.title: The Weight of Memory
lose.body: The junk remains. Some things simply cannot be packed away.
lose.quote: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.
